postprocessing.selection_basis: On revealed v7 evidence, five of six owner-reported missed helmet instances had matching high-score boxes removed by the geometry filter. Maximum relative area 0.14 and maximum relative height 0.40 are the smallest round-number outward bounds covering all five. Across all 432 revealed Train calibration/audit images this retained calibration precision 0.9057 and revealed-audit precision 0.9541 at threshold 0.023. Aspect bounds remain unchanged.

sampling.selection_basis: Preserve the v7 empty-image and close-pair weights. The only v7 owner-reported miss not recoverable by the preregistered geometry relaxation was a very small helmet with relative annotation area 0.0063 and a matching score of 0.0052. Weight Train images containing a helmet at or below the outward-rounded relative area 0.0075 by two.
